units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:1">Ex. R. s. 3</cite>, beg. <he>ט׳ היה וכ׳</he> Moses was a novice in prophecy.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:1:4">Y. Erub. V, beg. 22ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 17:1">I Kings XVII, 1</cite>, where Elijah is for the first time mentioned as a prophet and yet says, ‘the Lord before whom I stood’) <he>והלא אלי׳ ט׳ לנבואה היה</he> (not <he>טירונין לנביאים</he>) was not Elijah at that time a novice &c.?—Pl. <he>טִירוֹנִין</he>. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 1 <he>לעסק ט׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="I00735"><he>טרופין</he></cite>, corr. acc.) for the levy of soldiers; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>עליהם טירבוס</he> (corr. acc.).
